verdicts.title: Multiplicative differential algebraic K-theory and applications
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We construct a version of Beilinson's regulator as a map of sheaves of commutative ring spectra and use it to define a multiplicative variant of differential algebraic K-theory. We use this theory to give an interpretation of Bloch's construction of K_3-classes and the relation with dilogarithms. Furthermore, we provide a relation to Arakelov theory via the arithmetic degree of metrized line bundles, and we give a proof of the formality of the algebraic K-theory of number rings.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract of the cited paper discusses the construction of Beilinson's regulator, multiplicative differential algebraic K-theory, and its relation to Arakelov theory. It does not provide any information about resolution proof tree width, tropicalized Boolean algebras, or the minimal rank of K-theory over these algebras, which are central to the conjecture under review.

verdicts.title: Twisted iterated algebraic K-theory and topological T-duality for sphere bundles
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce a periodic form of the iterated algebraic K-theory of ku, the (connective) complex K-theory spectrum, as well as a natural twisting of this cohomology theory by higher gerbes. Furthermore, we prove a form of topological T-duality for sphere bundles oriented with respect to this theory.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract focuses on the introduction of a periodic form of iterated algebraic K-theory and topological T-duality for sphere bundles, but it does not provide any information regarding resolution proof tree width or the relationship between K-theory over tropicalized Boolean algebras and the complexity of Tseitin formulas.

verdicts.title: The plethory of operations in complex topological K-theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We provide a concrete introduction to the topologised, graded analogue of an algebraic structure known as a plethory, originally due to Tall and Wraith. Stacey and Whitehouse showed this structure is present on the cohomology operations for a suitable generalised cohomology theory. We compute an explicit expression for the plethory of operations for complex topological K-theory.
